brief: Paste the product's specs: name, materials, sizes, what is in the box, care, who it is for.
name: Product page copy
description: Writes the title, bullets, description and meta description of a product from its specs, checked for claims the specs do not back, with the lengths measured by code.

steps.prompt: Is every claim backed by the specs? No health, eco or "best" claims the specs do not prove, no invented sizes or materials. Is it still valid JSON with the four fields?
